svg.title: The split has to mirror how the model gets used
svg.desc: Four split strategies drawn as bars: a single hold-out at sd 0.0116, five folds at sd 0.0032, a grouped bar of eight customers with a red cut struck out where a random split slices through one customer's rows costing four points of lie, and a time-series staircase with a crossed-out backward arrow that trains on the future for fifteen AUC points, beside a nested cross-validation sketch and an adversarial-validation scatter scoring AUC 0.7902 against a 0.5070 control.
svg.text: The split has to mirror how the model gets used
the split has to mirror how the model gets used.
